Stop, Pisces—the stars are exposing hidden motives, and trusting that story could cost you now.

Neptune, your Water Element ruler, is around 1° Aries in your 2nd House; Pluto, in Aquarius in your 12th House, forms a close square to it. This 12th-to-2nd-house tension mixes self-worth, money, and secrecy, so facts must lead.

In love, the 7th House favors a slow reveal. If single, attract someone transparent about money, boundaries, and emotional availability; if attached, ask about the concern they are avoiding.

Career and money activate in your 6th House as Jupiter in Leo favors negotiating better pay through specialist work. Resubmit that overlooked invoice or proposal now; persistent follow-up brings a late response.

Avoid dodging a money conversation with secrecy right now; hidden costs only multiply.

Follow for tomorrow’s Pisces reading, and subscribe before Pluto reveals a hidden agenda.
